description: This file defines the Header class within the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation. It manages HTTP header names and their associated values, providing methods to retrieve, add, and manipulate header data.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP header, storing the original and normalized header names, as well as their values. Provides methods for manipulating header values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Header instance with the original name, normalized name, and initial values.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a single value to the header values and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: addValues
methods.description: Adds multiple values or a single value to the header. Throws an exception if input is invalid.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns all values associated with this header.
